directions: Soften yeast in warm water. Add sugar, salt, and white flour. Beat until smooth.
Set in a warm place until light and bubbly.
Combine hot water with brown sugar and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.
Combine both mixtures. Add whole wheat flour and mix until smooth.
Knead until smooth and elastic. Let rise until doubled.
Place in greased loaf pans and let rise until doubled again.
